_README: Curated by hand from Council Directive 2006/112/EC and national sources. NEVER scraped:
the Commission's own 'Territorial status of EU countries and certain territories' summary
page, read programmatically, reports the Canary Islands, Mount Athos, the Aland Islands and
the French overseas departments as INSIDE the EU VAT area. Article 6 says the opposite.
vat_area        false = the Directive does not reach this place at all (Art. 6, or OCT
status). Resolution THROWS; this is not the same as a 0% rate.
rate_override   inside the VAT area but at its own standard rate.
treat_as        billed as another member state (Art. 7).
legal_basis     the article or statute. Verified against primary law.
postal_source   where the postal rule came from. National data, never EU-published.
verified_on     when a human last checked the postal rule against that source.
Matching: EXACT postal codes are tried before prefixes, and longer prefixes before shorter,
so Saint-Martin (97150) and Saint-Barthelemy (97133) win over the 971 Guadeloupe prefix.
See VERIFICATION.md for what has and has not been checked.

busingen.name: Büsingen am Hochrhein
busingen.legal_basis: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 6(2)(b); UStG §1 Abs. 2 Satz 1 excludes it from 'Inland'.
busingen.note: A German exclave inside Switzerland. It also carries a Swiss postal code, CH-8238; an order addressed that way arrives as a Swiss order and never reaches this rule.
busingen.postal_source: Deutsche Post PLZ 78266 (sole municipality); IHK Hochrhein-Bodensee guidance on Büsingen VAT treatment

heligoland.name: Heligoland
heligoland.legal_basis: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 6(2)(a); UStG §1 Abs. 2 Satz 1 excludes it from 'Inland'.
heligoland.postal_source: Deutsche Post PLZ 27498 (sole municipality, Kreis Pinneberg, Schleswig-Holstein)

canary_islands.name: Canary Islands
canary_islands.note: Subject to IGIC, a local indirect tax (general rate 7%), not EU VAT. TEDB reports the 7% as an ES STANDARD row commented 'VAT - Canary Islands - '.
canary_islands.postal_source: Correos: the first two digits of a Spanish postal code are the province — 35 Las Palmas, 38 Santa Cruz de Tenerife, the two Canary provinces

ceuta.name: Ceuta
ceuta.note: Subject to IPSI, not EU VAT.
ceuta.postal_source: Correos: province code 51 is the autonomous city of Ceuta and nothing else

melilla.name: Melilla
melilla.note: Subject to IPSI, not EU VAT.
melilla.postal_source: Correos: province code 52 is the autonomous city of Melilla and nothing else

saint_martin.name: Saint-Martin
saint_martin.note: Exact code, matched before the 971 Guadeloupe prefix it sits inside — the two were detached from Guadeloupe in 2007 but kept 971xx postal codes.

saint_barthelemy.name: Saint-Barthélemy
saint_barthelemy.legal_basis: Overseas country and territory (OCT) since 2012 — TFEU Art. 355(2) and Annex II. Outside the EU entirely, therefore outside the VAT territory.
saint_barthelemy.note: Not an Art. 6 case: it left the EU rather than being carved out of the VAT area. Same outcome, different reason. Exact code, matched before the 971 prefix.

guadeloupe.name: Guadeloupe
guadeloupe.postal_source: La Poste: overseas departments are identified by the first three digits; 971 is Guadeloupe

corsica.name: Corsica
corsica.legal_basis: Inside the VAT area at France's 20% standard rate, but with its own special reduced rates under CGI art. 297 — 0.9%, 2.1%, 10% and 13%.
corsica.note: No standard-rate override: Corsica charges the same 20% as the mainland, so an ordinary sale resolves identically. The entry exists so the island's special REDUCED rates are recognised as regional and do not publish as French national bands, which is how a 0.9% rate would otherwise appear to be available across France.
corsica.postal_source: La Poste: both Corsican departments (2A Corse-du-Sud, 2B Haute-Corse) use codes beginning 20, the number assigned before the 1976 split

saint_pierre_et_miquelon.name: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon
saint_pierre_et_miquelon.legal_basis: Overseas country and territory (OCT) — TFEU Art. 355(2) and Annex II. Outside the EU, therefore outside the VAT territory.

french_southern_territories.name: French Southern and Antarctic Lands
french_southern_territories.legal_basis: Overseas country and territory (OCT) — TFEU Art. 355(2) and Annex II.
french_southern_territories.postal_source: La Poste: 984 Terres australes et antarctiques françaises

wallis_and_futuna.name: Wallis and Futuna
wallis_and_futuna.legal_basis: Overseas country and territory (OCT) — TFEU Art. 355(2) and Annex II.

french_polynesia.name: French Polynesia
french_polynesia.legal_basis: Overseas country and territory (OCT) — TFEU Art. 355(2) and Annex II.

new_caledonia.name: New Caledonia
new_caledonia.legal_basis: Overseas country and territory (OCT) — TFEU Art. 355(2) and Annex II.

aland_islands.name: Åland Islands
aland_islands.note: Åland uses the Finnish five-digit system in the range 22000-22999, and Finland asks that the country code AX precede it. Both spellings are matched, since an address may arrive either way.
aland_islands.postal_source: Posti / UPU addressing guide: Åland 22000-22999, prefixed AX (Mariehamn AX-22100)

mount_athos.name: Mount Athos
mount_athos.postal_source: ELTA: 63086 Karyes, Agion Oros — the postal address of every monastery on the peninsula

aegean_islands.name: Aegean Islands (reduced-rate islands)
aegean_islands.legal_basis: Greek law applies a 30% reduction to the VAT rates on qualifying Aegean islands: 24% becomes 17%, and the reduced bands fall to 9%, 4% and 3%. Extended from 2026-01-01 to islands of the North Aegean Region, Samothrace (Evros), and the Dodecanese with populations up to 20,000. Tobacco and means of transport are excluded.
aegean_islands.note: QUALIFICATION IS BY ISLAND AND POPULATION, NOT BY POSTAL CODE. Roughly 24 islands qualify (Agathonisi, Agios Efstratios, Astypalaia, Ikaria, Kalymnos, Karpathos, Kasos, Kos, Lipsi, Leros, Lesvos, Limnos, Megisti, Nisyros, Oinousses, Patmos, Samothrace, Samos, Symi, Tilos, Fournoi, Chalki, Chios, Psara), and they do not occupy a contiguous postcode range — Greek codes interleave island and mainland addresses. Mapping them would need per-island verification nobody has done, and a wrong mapping charges 17% where 24% is due. So NO postal rule is defined: Greek addresses resolve at the mainland rate, which is right for the large majority and wrong for these islands. Fix by verifying the postcodes per island, adding them here with a rate_override of 17.00, and removing rate_unverified.

campione_ditalia.name: Campione d'Italia
campione_ditalia.note: An Italian exclave inside the Swiss canton of Ticino. It joined the EU customs territory on 2020-01-01 but remains outside the VAT territory.
campione_ditalia.postal_source: Poste Italiane CAP 22061 (province of Como, Lombardy)

livigno.name: Livigno
livigno.postal_source: Poste Italiane CAP 23041 (province of Sondrio); 23030 is the pre-renumbering code and is kept because older addresses still carry it

lake_lugano_italian_waters.name: Italian waters of Lake Lugano
lake_lugano_italian_waters.note: No postal code: it is a body of water, not an addressable place. Recorded for completeness; unreachable by postcode resolution.

jungholz_mittelberg.name: Jungholz and Mittelberg
jungholz_mittelberg.legal_basis: UStG 1994 §10(4) — 19% rather than Austria's 20%. Corroborated independently by TEDB, which reports an AT REDUCED 19.0 row commented 'Jungholz, Mittelberg'.
jungholz_mittelberg.note: Two alpine exclaves reachable only through Germany, and both also carry GERMAN postal codes for mail routing — Jungholz D-87491, Mittelberg D-87567/87568/87569. An order addressed with country DE will not match here; it will resolve as German, which happens to be the same 19% but attributes the sale to the wrong country for OSS. Only the Austrian spellings are matched, because claiming a German postcode is Austrian would be worse.
jungholz_mittelberg.postal_source: Österreichische Post: Jungholz A-6691 (Tyrol); Mittelberg/Kleinwalsertal A-6991, 6992, 6993 (Vorarlberg)

madeira.name: Madeira
madeira.legal_basis: Inside the VAT area — an outermost region under TFEU Art. 349 but NOT listed in Directive Art. 6, unlike the French territories. Regional rates set under Portuguese law (Código do IVA).
madeira.note: Standard 22%, intermediate 12%, super-reduced 4% (4% from 2024-10-01). Only the standard rate is modelled here; a reduced-rate line in Madeira needs the Portuguese schedule, which this package does not carry.

azores.name: Azores
azores.legal_basis: Inside the VAT area — an outermost region under TFEU Art. 349 but NOT listed in Directive Art. 6. Regional rates set under Portuguese law (Código do IVA).
azores.note: Standard 16%, intermediate 9%, super-reduced 4%. Only the standard rate is modelled here.

monaco.name: Monaco
monaco.legal_basis: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 7(1) — 'shall not be regarded ... as third countries'; Art. 7(2) requires transactions to be treated as French.
monaco.postal_source: Monaco uses the single postal code 98000 for the whole principality

isle_of_man.name: Isle of Man
isle_of_man.legal_basis: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 7(1)-(2) — treated as the United Kingdom.
isle_of_man.note: GB is not published by TEDB, so this entry documents the treatment without resolving to a rate: a lookup raises UnknownCountry rather than returning silence.
isle_of_man.postal_source: Royal Mail: the IM postcode area, introduced 1993, covers the whole island

northern_ireland.name: Northern Ireland
northern_ireland.legal_basis: Windsor Framework / Protocol on Ireland-Northern Ireland: EU VAT rules continue to apply to GOODS, at UK rates. VAT numbers take the XI prefix.
northern_ireland.note: Goods only — services follow UK domestic rules. GB is not published by TEDB, so no rate resolves here; the entry exists so that a BT address is recognised as a special case rather than passing silently as ordinary GB.
northern_ireland.postal_source: Royal Mail: the BT postcode area covers Northern Ireland

akrotiri_and_dhekelia.name: Akrotiri and Dhekelia
akrotiri_and_dhekelia.note: No distinct postal rule: the Sovereign Base Areas use Cypriot addressing, so no postcode could distinguish them. Recorded for completeness.
